sources.summary: Neill’s longtime representative says the actor’s family agreed to release the information due to ‘inaccuracies and outright falsehoods’ in media Gillian Armstrong remembers Sam Neill: ‘I can’t believe that the very next day he was gone’ Sam Neill’s final interview and his life in pictures Sam Neill’s cause of death was pneumonia, his longtime representative has revealed. The 78-year-old actor’s “sudden and unexpected” death was announced on Monday , just three months after Neill revealed he was finally cancer-free since being diagnosed with stage three angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, a type of blood cancer, in 2022.
